The repository converted the classifications, FoR and SEO definitions and exclusions, and explanatory notes from the spreadsheet tables to JSON. FoR and SEO division labels use sentence case. The repository prepared FoR display translations independently and assigned machine-readable identifiers to the four named ToA categories.

The ToA descriptions are summaries written by the repository. Consult the original ABS ToA workbook above for official definitions. ANZSRC draws on the OECD Frascati Manual 2015, available separately under OECD terms.
OECD (2015), Frascati Manual 2015, https://doi.org/10.1787/9789264239012-en
OECD terms https://www.oecd.org/en/about/terms-conditions.html

See the ABS and Stats NZ copyright pages above for their notices and disclaimers. The repository is independently operated.
